issue_context.title: cover reproduce state does not handle tilt only covers
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Recently got Serena Wood tilt blinds in my kitchen and wanted to add them to my existing "media playing" scene which closes shades and lights downstairs, really basic:

```
scene:
  - name: Living Room Media Playing
    id: 2b63bf0b-6c04-4ff7-841a-d6d50012f80b
    icon: mdi:television-play
    entities:
      cover.living_room_shades:
        state: "closed"
      cover.dining_room_shade:
        state: "closed"
      cover.kitchen_blinds:
        state: "closed"

```

The two Serena Honeycomb shades (`cover.dining_room_shade` and `cover.living_room_shades`) have always worked perfectly for years and close as expected, but the Serena Wood Blinds as part of this same scene are not closing. This shows up in the system logs: 

```
Area - Living Room: Choose at step 1: Media Playing: Error executing script. Error for call_service at pos 2: Entity cover.kitchen_blinds does not support action cover.close_cover

Area - Living Room: Error executing script. Error for choose at pos 1: Entity cover.kitchen_blinds does not support action cover.close_cover
```
The problem seems to be that it's calling the `cover.close_cover` service rather than the proper `cover.close_cover_tilt` service when trying to apply the scene. 

🛑 This scene fails:
```
id: "1738464726279"
name: Kitchen Blinds Temp Scene
entities:
  cover.kitchen_blinds:
    state: "closed"
```

✅ This scene works and gets the desired result of closing the blinds, but it feels wrong to have to do this kind of workaround:

```
id: "1738464726279"
name: Kitchen Blinds Temp Scene
entities:
  cover.kitchen_blinds:
    state: "open"
    current_tilt_position: 0
```

These are the attributes when kitchen blinds are in "closed" state:

```
current_tilt_position: 0
device_id: "61"
zone_id: "49"
device_class: blind
friendly_name: Kitchen Blinds
supported_features: 176
```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2025.2.0b5 (this is NOT beta related though, was happening on stable too)

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Lutron Caséta

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lutron_caseta/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml

```

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt

```

### Additional information

_No response_

These are tilt only covers https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/cdead8661d7c0a8fbdfd51f3b5039af5b1d30a21/homeassistant/components/lutron_caseta/cover.py#L62

They don't support `cover.close_cover` because the entity doesn't include the `CoverEntityFeature.CLOSE` feature and the scene platform reproduce state doesn't know to call `SERVICE_CLOSE_COVER_TILT` or `SERVICE_OPEN_COVER_TILT` when the state is closed when it doesn't support `CoverEntityFeature.CLOSE`

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/cdead8661d7c0a8fbdfd51f3b5039af5b1d30a21/homeassistant/components/cover/reproduce_state.py#L78

Reproduce state probably needs to be changed to check if close is supported, and if not supported and tilt close is send the tilt close service call
